sloka: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे वीरो गदापाणिर्विभीषणः ।सुग्रीवं वर्धयामास राघवं च निरैक्षत ।। ६.५०.७ ।।।।
transliteration: etasminnantare vīro gadāpāṇirvibhīṣaṇaḥ ।sugrīvaṁ vardhayāmāsa rāghavaṁ ca niraikṣata ।। 6.50.7 ।।।।

translations.english: In the meantime, heroic Vibheeshana holding mace came to Sugriva and Rama and cheered with victory.
